subject: POC Plan & Final Readout Scheduling - Zenwell Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@zenwell.com>, Mike Chan <mike.chan@zenwell.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed PoC plan and next steps

Hi Sara / Mike —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan heading into the PoC: 

Summary of needs:
- Zenwell wants a secure, low-latency clinical summarization flow for patient discharge notes (avg doc length ~1.2k tokens)
- Success criteria: 95% coverage of required fields, average response latency <750ms p50, and model hallucination rate <1% on test prompts
- Compliance: SOC 2 + VPC peering for PHI in the PoC environment

Proposed PoC plan (high level):
- Duration: 3 weeks (pilot week + 2 weeks evaluation)
- Deliverables: integration guide, sample streams, evaluation set + scoring script, final readout deck
- Owners: Marissa (project lead / commercial), Marcus (SE / technical lead), Rishi (customer success / onboarding)

Next steps I propose:
1) Marcus to send PoC plan w/ concrete success criteria and evaluation approach (attached v1).
2) Zenwell to confirm dataset access, and nominate 1-2 SME reviewers for quality checks.
3) Schedule a final readout + exec decision meeting in mid-May (target week of May 10th) — please share exec availability.

I've attached the PoC plan draft and a success criteria template for you to annotate. Marcus — feel free to add technical notes.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Zenwell_PoC_Plan_v2.xlsx; PoC_Success_Criteria.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@zenwell.com>, Mike Chan <mike.chan@zenwell.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed PoC plan and next steps

Thanks Marissa — added technical detail below and updated the attached plan.

Technical notes / clarifications:
- Runtime: we'll provision a dedicated instance (1xA10g equiv) to hit latency SLOs for the expected concurrency.
- Data handling: recommend VPC peering + short-lived signed URLs for dataset ingestion. No data will be logged to hosted catalogs during the PoC unless agreed.
- Eval approach: will provide an evaluation harness (Python) that runs the Zenwell test set and outputs coverage, hallucination counts, and latency percentiles.

Success criteria (proposed concrete metrics):
- Field coverage (automated): >=95% exact-match across target fields on evaluation set
- Clinical hallucination: <=1% (measured by SME review on random sample of 200 outputs)
- Latency: p50 < 750ms, p95 < 1.5s on the staged workload
- Ops: no unplanned downtime >5 minutes across the PoC window

I've attached the updated Zenwell_PoC_Plan_v2.xlsx with an evaluation checklist and a short runbook for dataset ingestion.

Marcus
Marcus Lin | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: Zenwell_PoC_Plan_v2.xlsx

From: Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@zenwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Chan <mike.chan@zenwell.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed PoC plan and next steps

Hi Marissa / Marcus —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side after reviewing the plan: 
- Timeline: Mid-May readout works for us, but can we compress the pilot week? We have limited SME bandwidth and would prefer a 2-week evaluation window with focused sampling (pilot + 1 week eval).
- Success criteria: the automated field coverage metric looks good. For hallucination tolerance, we prefer <=0.5% on the SME sample (we can expand sample size if needed).
- Security: will need a SOC 2 attestation + confirmation of VPC peering steps in writing before we send any PHI.

Owners: I'll nominate Dr. Laura Benson as SME (cc'd via calendar invite shortly) and Mike will manage dataset provisioning.

Can Marcus update the plan for a 2-week evaluation model and include the expanded SME sampling option (we can confirm sample size in follow-up)? Also please add the SOC 2 attestation note in the security section.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Taylor | Director of Clinical Operations, Zenwell Health
sara.taylor@zenwell.com | +1 617-555-0122

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@zenwell.com>, Mike Chan <mike.chan@zenwell.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed PoC plan and next steps

Great — thanks Sara. 

Plan update: Marcus will revise the plan to a 2-week evaluation (pilot week + 1 week focused eval) and add the SOC 2 attestation note. We'll also prepare the SME sampling options (200 / 400 / 800) with the tradeoffs by next Tuesday.

Action items / owners: 
- Marcus: update PoC plan + runbook, SOC 2 language, and sampling options (owner: Marcus; due: 2027-04-18)
- Zenwell: confirm dataset access & Dr. Laura Benson as SME (owner: Sara; due: 2027-04-16)
- Rishi: prepare onboarding checklist and calendar invites for integration calls (owner: Rishi; due: 2027-04-19)
- Marissa: schedule final readout + exec decision meeting (target week of May 10th)

For scheduling: what does May 10–14 look like for the Zenwell exec team? If you share 2-3 preferred slots I’ll lock one and send a calendar invite with agenda.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@zenwell.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Chan <mike.chan@zenwell.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Updated PoC plan + evaluation options (attached)

Hi all —

Attached is Zenwell_PoC_Plan_v2.xlsx (updated) and PoC_Success_Criteria.docx. Key changes:
- PoC duration changed to 2 weeks (pilot + focused eval) per Zenwell request
- Added SME sampling options: 200 (baseline), 400 (recommended), 800 (comprehensive) with estimated review hours
- SOC 2 attestation language added and VPC peering checklist included in the runbook

Please review and comment by 2027-04-20 so we can lock dates. 

Also: I've provisionally booked three candidate slots for the final readout (exec + stakeholders) during the week of May 10th — see below. Marissa, can you confirm which to send to Zenwell?
- Tue May 11, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Wed May 12, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Thu May 13, 14:00–14:45 PT

Marcus

Attachments: Zenwell_PoC_Plan_v2.xlsx; PoC_Success_Criteria.docx; redwood_poc_readout_template.pdf

From: Sara Taylor <sara.taylor@zenwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Chan <mike.chan@zenwell.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated PoC plan + evaluation options (attached)

Marissa / Marcus —

Thanks for the updates. We reviewed the materials and Dr. Benson prefers the 400-sample SME review (balancing confidence vs. effort). Security team confirmed SOC 2 attestation is sufficient to proceed with VPC peering next week. Mike will send dataset access by Friday 4/16.

As for the final readout slot, the exec team is available on Wed May 12, 09:00–09:45 PT — please lock that and send a calendar invite with the agenda (exec review + go/no-go + next steps).

On the commercial side, assuming a positive readout the next step for contracting will be a short-term Dedicated capacity pilot agreement (term sheet + DocuSign). Can you include the draft term sheet in the readout deck? We want leadership to see the proposed commercial path.

I'll await the calendar invite and dataset access.

Best,
Sara
